**Kit preparation (first use)**

(@) Add the 1 mL Primer Mix (10X) to the 5 mL bottle of SYBR FAST Master Mix (2X); vortex briefly.
(@) Store the combined mix at −20 °C (or 4 °C for short-term use, per kit insert); keep away from light.
(@) Thaw the standards on ice, vortex and spin down. Do not dilute the standards further.

**Library dilutions (serial, in library dilution buffer)**

| Dilution | Make from | Volume taken (µL) | Dilution buffer (µL) | Use |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| 1:1 000 | Pool | 1 | 999 | Intermediate only |
| 1:10 000 | 1:1 000 | 100 | 900 | Run in qPCR |
| 1:20 000 | 1:1 000 | 50 | 950 | Run in qPCR |
| 1:100 000 (optional) | 1:10 000 | 10 | 90 | If PicoGreen > c. 50 nM |

(@) Prepare the dilutions above. Vortex and spin each dilution before taking the next step. Check against the PicoGreen value: the diluted library should be about 0.2–20 pM, inside the standard range.

**Positive control:** treat the positive control like a library. It starts at 200 nM and is diluted in the same series: 1:1 000 (intermediate), then 1:10 000 and 1:20 000, which should give about 20 pM and 10 pM in the reaction.

**Reaction set-up (20 µL per well)**

| Component | Per well (µL) |
|:--|--:|
| Master Mix + Primer Mix (combined) | 12 |
| PCR-grade water | 4 |
| Diluted library, standard or NTC buffer | 4 |

(@) Prepare a master mix of 12 µL combined mix + 4 µL water per well, plus 10% excess.
(@) Dispense 16 µL per well, then add 4 µL of diluted library, standard or dilution buffer (for the NTC).
(@) Seal, spin briefly, and keep the plate in the dark until loading.

**Plate layout (96-well):** Standards 1–6 in triplicate (18 wells); NTC (dilution buffer as template) in duplicate (2 wells); positive control and each library at 1:10 000 and 1:20 000 in triplicate (6 wells each). With the positive control, up to 11 libraries fit on one plate (18 + 2 + 6 + 6 × 11 = 92 wells). In the software, enter the standards as *Standard* with quantities 20, 2, 0.2, 0.02, 0.002 and 0.0002 pM (S1–S6).

**Cycling**

| Step | Temperature | Time | Cycles |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Initial denaturation | 95 °C | 5 min | 1 |
| Denaturation | 95 °C | 30 s | 35 |
| Annealing/extension + read | 60 °C | 45 s | |
| Melt curve | 65 °C, then to 95 °C at 0.15 °C/s | 15 s at each temperature | 1 |

Ramp rate 1.6 °C/s for all other steps (instrument settings in use).

(@) Run the plate on the qPCR instrument (QuantStudio 3) with the cycling above.
(@) Export the results as .csv (tab *Export*) and check the run against the run QC criteria before calculating.
